subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should per-conversation inbound debounce be a WhatsApp-only configuration feature, or should OpenClaw instead establish the generic plugin debounce-policy contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both open PRs solve the same canonical WhatsApp use case through materially different permanent contracts: one adds a channel-owned configuration option, while the other expands a generic plugin API. The repository policy requires a maintainer choice before adding new configuration or plugin API surface.

options.title: Sponsor WhatsApp-local configuration
options.body: Adopt this bounded WhatsApp-owned `groups` and `direct` setting, then require installed-account behavior proof and exact-head green checks before merge.

options.title: Choose the generic plugin seam
options.body: Pause or close this branch and use the plugin-policy proposal only if maintainers want other channels to own equivalent per-message debounce behavior.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Keep the canonical request open without landing either new permanent surface until a maintainer defines the desired product scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor WhatsApp-local configuration
recommendation.body: Adopt this bounded WhatsApp-owned `groups` and `direct` setting, then require installed-account behavior proof and exact-head green checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the only concrete recent owner of the affected implementation, while maintainer sponsorship itself is not established in the supplied context.
